What is Turiya Trails

A conscious Himalayan
experience company

Rooted in stillness, awareness, and presence. We do not rush summits or chase thrill. We walk slowly, listening to forests, skies, and ourselves.

Inspired by Turiya, the fourth state of consciousness beyond waking, dreaming, and deep sleep, our journeys guide you beyond noise and distraction, toward clarity and inner freedom.

Our home base is Oakakhi, Ranikhet, a quiet stay near Kalika, nestled deep in the Kumaun Himalayas, where every journey begins.

Freedom is not running away.
Freedom is seeing clearly.

The Turiya Philosophy

"What does freedom mean to you?"

  • Spiritual seekers and meditators

  • Those quietly drawn, not just excited

"When do you feel most like yourself?"

Our Guides

Grounded companions,
not entertainers

Trained in safety, Himalayan terrain, nature awareness, birdwatching, and astro guided storytelling. Our guides hold space with humility. They speak when the mountain speaks. Silent when silence is needed.

Himalayan Safety Birdwatching Astro Storytelling Nature Interpretation Mindful Guiding

The Turiya Oath

Words we walk by

  • I will walk with awareness, not just legs.
  • I will be kind to animals and to the Earth.
  • I will leave nature better than I found it.
  • I will stay curious. Ask the harder questions.
  • I will respect silence and fellow travelers.
  • I will return not just changed, but clear.
